purpose: Teach: 付着/印鑑/コンペ/足場/自粛/増減/連覇/鉄人

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠品に、本気で、絶対、犯人の指紋、絶対、付着しておりました、本気で、捜査、進めております、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: The evidence shows the perpetrator's fingerprints were definitely found. We're pursuing the investigation seriously, and we're grateful for your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Clear articulation on key facts. Steady pacing. Professional distance maintained but genuine gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、印鑑管理、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company takes seal and stamp management very seriously. We're grateful for your thorough work.
lines.style: Respectful, aligned with the officer's formality. Slightly deferential without being obsequious. Each phrase lands with care.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、地域防犯コンペ、絶対、進めております、本気で、市民の安全、第一、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police department is actively working on the local crime prevention competition. Citizen safety is our top priority, and we appreciate your company's support.
lines.style: Official announcement register. Slightly formal, but warm conviction on 'citizen safety.' Steady tempo, confident delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の警備の足場、本気で、絶対、しっかり、固めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've solidified our security foundation and we're committed to maintaining it. Thank you for your partnership.
lines.style: Assured, calm. Light emphasis on 'solidified' — showing confidence without arrogance. Warm close on the gratitude.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、自粛要請、絶対、市民、絶対、ご協力、感謝、しております、本気で、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: We're asking the public to exercise self-restraint and caution. We're truly grateful for everyone's cooperation in keeping our community safe.
lines.style: Official but human. Opens with clarity, builds toward genuine appreciation. Slight warmth breaks through procedure on the final clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。犯罪の増減、本気で、絶対、毎月、絶対、警察、報告、感謝、しております
lines.en: Yes. We receive monthly crime reports from your department and we're grateful for that regular communication. It helps us understand the full picture.
lines.style: Attentive, engaged. Shows he's been listening and values the data. Steady, thoughtful pace. Honest respect for the information-sharing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯コンクール、本気で、絶対、連覇、絶対、目指して、本気で、警察、絶対、頑張ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're aiming for consecutive victories in the crime prevention competition. The police will continue to do our best, and we appreciate your company's efforts alongside ours.
lines.style: Forward-looking determination. Slight lift on 'consecutive victories' — ambition without boasting. Measured close, acknowledging the partnership.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察官、本気で、絶対、鉄人並みの、絶対、お仕事、絶対、敬意、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your officers work with tireless dedication. We have deep respect for that level of commitment, and we're grateful.
lines.style: Sincere, almost understated. Lands firmly on 'tireless dedication.' Warm closing — not effusive but genuinely felt gratitude.
